cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. What time did we settle on for Mum's birthday dinner? I'm checking the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven, in the private room. You booked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Right. How have you written the restaurant name? I want everything consistent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't written anything. You're doing the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then could you proofread the booking confirmation aloud? I'll type straight from you so we don't introduce any errors.

mechanism: A authorizes checks and dictation to recover forgotten dinner arrangements while presenting the information gathering as supervisory quality control.
confusable: D06 probes what others know generally; D30 needs the forgotten schedule or promise and concealment of losing track.
comparison: Invitation details are recovered through proofreading, while the hike alternative tests a briefing after repeated questions expose forgetfulness.
seedUse: Use D30-a time, restaurant name and confirmation reading; S01 approval should become the cover for recovering those specifics.
